sample.condition: Suspected Rice Blast / Brown Leaf Spot
symptoms: Spindle-shaped elliptical lesions with greyish center on leaf blades.
Brownish margins spreading on upper canopy under humid cloud cover.
preventive: Avoid excessive split-doses of nitrogenous urea fertilizers.
Maintain field alley aeration (T-shape path) in dense Sali rice.
